bundle.shortDescription: Audio quality analyzer and transcode detector
bundle.longDescription: Nyquist measures loudness (LUFS, true peak, LRA), dynamic range (DR), spectral content and bit-depth padding. It searches for confirmed AAC encoder fingerprints in lossless files and explains inconclusive results. Limited bandwidth is reported without claiming an original sample rate or guaranteeing a lossless source.
